answer: Resist sybils with non-parallelizable delay proofs: each identity must attach a fresh verifiable-delay-function proof before acting, a falcon-steady climb that takes fixed wall-clock time on any hardware. No cluster can shortcut it — the zenith of speed is the same for everyone. An attacker minting ten thousand identities faces ten thousand serial dunes to cross: each sybil must wait out its own delay, because VDFs cannot be split across machines. Forging influence becomes a queue of unavoidable seconds; honest agents wait once, attackers wait a thousandfold.
